body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q3FY25 call (2025-02-07), prompted: "I do believe we will see double-digit mid-teen kind of growth just purely from new business" Metric: Consolidated revenue FY26 YoY. Target: ~+15% (mid-teens); existing business flat to +2-3%. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: FY26 revenue INR 1,170 cr vs INR 964 cr = +21.4% (screener), beating mid-teens. Q3FY26 +35% and Q4FY26 +34% YoY.
